label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) alert-TP: User-controlled 'seg' parameter directly concatenated into redirect URL path at line 24 ('https://' + host + '/' + seg). While 'host' is validated via regex, the path segment 'seg' has NO sanitization/validation before being included in the redirect target. Attacker can craft malicious URLs like https://example.safe.com/../etc/passwd or https://example.safe.com/.htaccess to perform SSRF or access sensitive resources.

evidence.note: User-controlled 'seg' parameter flows directly to redirect URL without validation
